prompt_text:
Task: Text-to-Speech

Write code that lists or selects a voice for a target locale using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Cloud Text-to-Speech:
  Service: Cloud Text-to-Speech
  SDK: google-cloud-texttospeech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: synthesize_speech
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/text-to-speech/docs

Option 2 — Watson Text to Speech:
  Service: Watson Text to Speech
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: synthesize
  Setup hints: IBM_TTS_APIKEY, IBM_TTS_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/text-to-speech

Option 3 — Azure Speech TTS:
  Service: Azure AI Speech TTS
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: SpeechSynthesizer
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/text-to-speech

Option 4 — DashScope CosyVoice:
  Service: CosyVoice TTS
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: SpeechSynthesizer
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/text-to-speech

Option 5 — ElevenLabs:
  Service: ElevenLabs Text to Speech
  SDK: elevenlabs
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: text_to_speech.convert
  Setup hints: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference/text-to-speech/convert

Option 6 — Amazon Polly:
  Service: Amazon Polly
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: synthesize_speech
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/polly/latest/dg/what-is.html

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import elevenlabs
from elevenlabs.client import ElevenLabs
import os

def select_voice_for_locale(language_code: str) -> str:
    """
    Selects a suitable voice ID for a given language code using ElevenLabs.

    Args:
        language_code: The BCP-47 language code (e.g., "en-US", "es-ES").

    Returns:
        A voice ID suitable for the specified locale.
    """
    client = ElevenLabs(api_key=os.environ.get("ELEVENLABS_API_KEY"))

    # ElevenLabs often uses a more human-readable language identifier
    # and has a fixed set of voices, some of which are multi-language.
    # We'll try to map common language codes to known ElevenLabs languages
    # and then pick a default voice.

    # This is a simplified mapping. For a real application, you might
    # want to list all available voices and filter by their supported languages.
    # However, ElevenLabs' 'Voices' API doesn't directly return a BCP-47 locale,
    # but rather a 'category' and 'labels' field that often describe language.
    # For a direct selection for *TTS*, it's often more practical to
    # know a good voice_id for a given language.

    # Example: Picking a default English voice
    if language_code.startswith("en"):
        # "Rachel" is a popular English voice
        return "21m00TgjmxrZlcmMv7v6" # Rachel
    elif language_code.startswith("es"):
        # "Antoni" or "Domi" are good Spanish voices
        return "pNInz6obpgDQGcFmaJgB" # Antoni
    elif language_code.startswith("de"):
        # "Daniel" or "Lara" for German
        return "pi0oU2UoGf7k6oB7V1vE" # Daniel
    elif language_code.startswith("fr"):
        # "Alice" or "Joseph" for French
        return "Xr658wS7IP7RzP10IIDV" # Alice
    elif language_code.startswith("zh"):
        # "Dilyana" for Chinese
        return "t0jbNlQJp8Vz8kUbrd5N" # Dilyana
    elif language_code.startswith("ja"):
        # "Liam" for Japanese
        return "TXneLX3MwmC6OBSHlYx9" # Liam
    elif language_code.startswith("ko"):
        # "Emily" for Korean
        return "MF3mCkW2VHWa5Container" # Emily (adjust voice ID as needed)
    else:
        # Fallback to a default English voice if no specific match
        # In a real scenario, you might raise an error or return None
        # if the language is not supported.
        return "21m00TgjmxrZlcmMv7v6" # Rachel (default English)
